pr_title: nspawn: don't hard fail when setting capabilities
pr_body:
The OCI changes in #9762 broke a use case in which we use nspawn from
inside a container that has dropped capabilities from the bounding set
that nspawn expected to retain. In an attempt to keep OCI compliance
and support our use case, I made hard failing on setting capabilities
not in the bounding set optional (hard fail if using OCI and log only
if using nspawn cmdline).

Fixes #12539

issue_context.title: systemd-nspawn unnecessarily setting capabilities that are not in the original set
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/de40a3037af944f6803375f2f5269cffc4247f56 swapped `drop_capabilities()` in nspawn/nspawn.c to call `capability_quintet_enforce` instead of `capability_bounding_set_drop`. If no capability related args are passed to nspawn and the current capability set is missing one of the capabilities in nspawn's default set of `arg_caps_retain`, then nspawn will attempt to set it. However this fails and nspawn will not start. For example, in a container started without `cap_sys_boot` (which is in `arg_caps_retain`):

```
[root@image /]# capsh --print
Current: = cap_chown,cap_dac_override,cap_dac_read_search,cap_fowner,cap_fsetid,cap_kill,cap_setgid,cap_setuid,cap_setpcap,cap_linux_immutable,cap_net_bind_service,cap_net_broadcast,cap_net_raw,cap_ipc_owner,cap_sys_chroot,cap_sys_ptrace,cap_sys_admin,cap_sys_nice,cap_sys_resource,cap_sys_tty_config,cap_mknod,cap_lease,cap_audit_write,cap_audit_control,cap_setfcap+ep
Bounding set =cap_chown,cap_dac_override,cap_dac_read_search,cap_fowner,cap_fsetid,cap_kill,cap_setgid,cap_setuid,cap_setpcap,cap_linux_immutable,cap_net_bind_service,cap_net_broadcast,cap_net_raw,cap_ipc_owner,cap_sys_chroot,cap_sys_ptrace,cap_sys_admin,cap_sys_nice,cap_sys_resource,cap_sys_tty_config,cap_mknod,cap_lease,cap_audit_write,cap_audit_control,cap_setfcap
Securebits: 00/0x0/1'b0
 secure-noroot: no (unlocked)
 secure-no-suid-fixup: no (unlocked)
 secure-keep-caps: no (unlocked)
uid=0(root)
gid=0(root)
groups=
[root@image /]# systemd-nspawn -x -- capsh --print
Spawning container image-ce38659d1e580c26 on /.#machine.e3cf534d32fd7351.
Press ^] three times within 1s to kill container.
Dropping capabilities failed: Operation not permitted
Child died too early.

```

With `cap_sys_boot` in the container this will work fine. Considering the name of the function I believe this is a bug and we should only be dropping capabilities, not setting additional ones. Can help with patches if this is not intended behavior.
